candidates.change_summary: Change the required msg.value from 10 ether to 11 ether, so calls with 10 ether no longer pass the require and thus pastBlockTime will not update.
Invert the timestamp comparison to require block.timestamp < pastBlockTime, altering which calls update pastBlockTime.
Remove the update to pastBlockTime so its value remains unchanged after fallback calls that pass requires.
Always transfer the contract balance to msg.sender by removing the block.number condition, changing state observed by callers receiving funds and leaving pastBlockTime as in original.
Change the modulo divisor in the conditional from 15 to 2, making payouts occur on different block numbers and thus altering observable balance transfers.
